name: humanizer
description: Writing rules for anything a person will read.

interface.shortDescription: Write so it does not read as machine-written.
interface.longDescription: The rules every reply answers to, a catalogue of the markers that make writing read as machine-written, and a checkable subset with tests. Applies them to an explanation, a recap and a definition.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this so it does not read as machine-written.
